en: Reverse side of an old postcard with printed multilingual wordings for 'postcard' across the top, a vertical dividing line, handwritten purple ink message on the left and address on the right. There is a green 5 pfennig stamp of the Deutsches Reich cancelled with a circular postmark that reads 'DRESDEN'. Along the left edge is a printed publisher credit in German mentioning 'Dresdner Kunstverlag Gustav Schmidt, Dresden A.27'.
